design_freeze.splits: TO_FREEZE_BEFORE_OUTCOMES: chronological walk-forward or fixed train/val/test boundaries determined by coverage-only audit; purge/embargo >= max forward horizon (>=168h per FCLR-001 context) or explicitly justified; no holdout outcome inspection.
design_freeze.features: TO_FREEZE_BEFORE_OUTCOMES: Gate 4 ablations A_rv_only/B_rv_signed/C_rv_abs/D_rv_signed_abs/E_rv_funding_trails; training-only normalization; funding availability/last-known at/before hour; no lookahead.
design_freeze.targets: TO_FREEZE_BEFORE_OUTCOMES: primary/secondary realized-volatility horizons and exact mark-price fields/units as per frozen protocol; FCLR-001/FCLR-003 anchors unchanged.
design_freeze.metrics: TO_FREEZE_BEFORE_OUTCOMES: paired ΔQLIKE primary where applicable, MAE/RMSE, block bootstrap CIs, DM/HAC as preregistered; claim-worthiness/inference thresholds explicit.
design_freeze.stop_rule: TO_FREEZE_BEFORE_OUTCOMES: stop on any unresolved leakage/provenance/license defect, failed guard, insufficient sample/blocks/instruments, or failed completeness audit; preserve NOT_SUPPORTED/INCONCLUSIVE/NO_GO; no threshold shopping.

promotion_requirements: Populate/resolve terms evidence with verifiable facts only (no fabrication); set license_terms_resolved=true only with RESOLVED_VERIFIED evidence.
Finalize exact splits/features/targets/metrics/stop rule and freeze before any outcome inspection; set frozen_before_outcomes=true, draft=false, promotable_to_frozen true only after freeze commit.
Ensure provenance manifest becomes v5 GO (confirmatory_provenance_go=true, admissibility_complete=true, license_terms RESOLVED_VERIFIED, no fabricated markers) and scope covers requested range.
Obtain FCLR-014/v5 guard acceptance evidence (run_funding_ablations check path / validator) with green tests; record command+result hashes.
Keep confirmatory_claim_go=NO_GO until every gate passes; no confirmatory outcomes on unprovenanced/incomplete 2025+.
